sessionRoot.description: Absolute, owner-only root outside the normal Pi session store; runtime checks platform-specific absolute paths

age.description: Optional recipient/identity pair, including age-plugin-yubikey. Absent: generate a passphrase-protected age identity for per-file encryption.

extensions.description: Additional extensions for /private only; pi-history-search defaults to the sibling index.ts and can be overridden here. /private nohistory ignores this entire object.
